runs.text: From fuzzy problem to tested prototype — Thursday 18 March 2027, Room 4B
Before we solve anything, we agree on what the problem actually is.
Fold an A4 sheet into eight panels. Sketch eight different ideas — one per minute. Quantity over quality; stick figures welcome.
Diverge — map the problem and generate as many ideas as possible.
Converge — pick one direction, build it fast and put it in front of real users.
